Enter Nabu-Ka

A city that remembers.
A queen who doesn’t.

Museum archivist Nyra Keene can explain almost anything—except the jackal statue moving through her museum without appearing on security footage.

When the God of Death emerges from its shadows and claims she was once his queen, Nyra has questions. And she intends to decide for herself who she is.

The Jackal trilogy

Meet the Jackal trilogy.

An adult romantic fantasy trilogy about identity, devotion, and the power to choose your own future. Marked by the Jackal is now available on Kindle and included with Kindle Unlimited. Paperback and hardcover editions are coming soon, with more books in the trilogy on the way.

Available on Kindle · Kindle Unlimited

Marked by the Jackal

Nyra’s missing friend, a mysterious artifact, and a possessive death god lead her to Nabu-Ka—a sentient city that calls her its lost queen. As the ruling Council pursues her, Nyra must unravel the power awakening inside her before an ancient weapon tears her soul from her body.

A mini novella

Protector of the Vael

Marla inherits her grandmother’s Victorian house, but the rooms hold more than memories. Hidden books, strange happenings, and a black cat named Ember lead her toward a family secret: the Vale women have protected the Vael for generations.

Now Marla must discover what her grandmother left behind—and what being its next protector will ask of her.

Follow the story in short daily chapters on my Blogtober blog, Beyond the Vael.

A world waiting to welcome you

Imagine arriving in a city that remembers you.

Even when you don’t remember it. Nabu-Ka is alive, magical, and waiting for its dead queen to return.

The writer behind the worlds

Hello, I’m Ashley.

I grew up in a small town where the library became my sanctuary. By seven, I was disappearing into books and inventing new stories for their characters in my head. I still fall asleep imagining stories of my own.

I’m a mother of six, a nursing student, and a nurse extern. Somewhere between work, school, and family life, I write fantasy, romance, and a little mischief.

Marked by the Jackal is my debut novel.

Beyond the Vael
